tagline: Unleash the full potential of your diverse workforce

features.name: Integrated Recruitment
features.summary: End-to-end recruitment software (via Zoho Recruit integration) with Zia candidate matching to hire faster and build a positive workplace culture.

features.name: Employee Onboarding
features.summary: Seamless onboarding workflows so new hires complete procedures quickly and hit the ground running from day one.

features.name: Employee Management
features.summary: Centralized employee database (DBMS) to securely store records, classify your workforce, and empower employees with self-service.

features.name: Attendance Management
features.summary: Web and mobile check-ins with IP and location-based restrictions, plus biometric integrations and facial recognition for real-time attendance.

features.name: Shift & Roster Management
features.summary: Define, manage, and regulate 24/7 shifts, breaks, and payable vs. non-payable work items.

features.name: Leave Management (Time-Off)
features.summary: Customizable time-off policies, easy leave submissions, quick approvals, and consolidated views of leave balances and holidays.

features.name: Timesheets
features.summary: Track ongoing and completed projects, allocate jobs, monitor team workloads, and bill clients accurately on time.

features.name: HR Help Desk
features.summary: Dedicated HR agents, built-in SLA capabilities, and an accessible knowledge base to resolve employee queries and grievances promptly.

features.name: Document Management
features.summary: Centralized repository to store files, generate documents from templates, request electronic signatures, and share securely.

features.name: Offboarding Management
features.summary: Structured clearance processes, responsibility transfers, exit interviews, access revocation, and compliant paperwork for departing employees.

features.name: Performance Management
features.summary: Appraisal dashboards and performance frameworks to track team performance, individual skills, and business outcomes.

features.name: OKR
features.summary: Align and motivate your workforce with outcome-driven Objectives and Key Results to drive accountability and visibility.

features.name: Compensation & Benefits
features.summary: Transparent compensation management with role-based salary structures, bonuses, allowances, and benefits administration.

features.name: Learning Management System (LMS)
features.summary: Personalized learning experiences based on department, experience, or role to support employee growth and upskilling.

features.name: Integrated Payroll
features.summary: Seamless Zoho People and Zoho Payroll integration for accurate, on-time pay runs and stress-free paydays.

features.name: Travel & Expense
features.summary: Integrated with Zoho Expense to record expenses, share receipts, and streamline reporting with real-time data sync.

features.name: Employee Engagement & Collaboration
features.summary: eNPS surveys, engagement surveys, and business chat/collaboration tools to foster belonging and measure workplace culture.

features.name: HR Analytics
features.summary: Comprehensive reports and analytics giving a bird's-eye view of HR metrics and overall business performance.

features.name: HR Automation & Custom Services
features.summary: Automate repetitive tasks with workflows, automatic field updates, mail alerts, webhooks, custom forms, and Zia AI.

features.name: Native & Third-Party Integrations
features.summary: Integrates with Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects, Zoho Mail, Zoho Sign, Zoho Payroll, Zoho Expense, Zoho Recruit, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Adobe Sign, GreytHR, and Zapier.

features.name: Mobile App (iOS & Android)
features.summary: HRMS in your pocket—apply for leave, log time, approve requests, and clock in/out with geo-fencing from anywhere.

features.name: Zia AI Assistant
features.summary: Built-in conversational AI assistant that lets employees check leave balances, punch in/out via chat, and get instant answers to HR policy queries.

pricing_india.free_trial: 30-day free trial on paid plans, no credit card required
pricing_india.tax_note: Prices exclude 18% GST; custom quotes available for 500+ users
pricing_india.payroll_note: Core Zoho People plans do not include payroll; payroll integrates via Zoho Payroll or the all-in-one Zoho People Plus suite

plans.name: Free
plans.highlights: Up to 5 users; basic employee database, document management, and leave tracking

plans.name: Essential HR
plans.highlights: Onboarding, offboarding, basic HR reports, workflows, and Zia AI assistant

plans.name: Professional
plans.highlights: Adds attendance management, shift & roster scheduling, and timesheets

plans.name: Premium
plans.highlights: Adds performance management (KRAs, goals, 360-degree feedback), compensation, and employee engagement

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.highlights: Adds HR help desk (SLAs & ticketing), Learning Management System (LMS), and sandbox environment
